scope: Read-only host-side inspection; no GPU execution, compilation, repository edit, or source ELF modification.

target.run: OpenFold3 N1536, B=32, H=4, D=32, float32

artifact_provenance.version_note: Torch reports HIP 7.14.60850; the resolved library is under core-10.0. A directory name alone does not establish a runtime version mismatch.

qk.accumulator_observation: Code uses a[0:3] and a[4:7] as MFMA accumulators with LDS staging, s_waitcnt and s_barrier. Disassembly has prologue/open/tail control flow; exact per-output runtime K sequence is not established from the symbol/static count alone.

variant_disambiguation.not_selected: A second PV variant at 0x499f00 has GLVWA1/GRVW1 and 64 static MFMA instructions; it does not match the trace name.

split_k_conclusion: Selected batched Tensile rows have DepthU=32, GSU=1, StreamK=0 and GlobalAccumulation=0, with no split-K/Stream-K cross-CTA accumulation. QK has reduction K=32 (one DepthU tile); PV has reduction K=1536 (48 DepthU tiles). Static instruction counts do not determine executed counts or scalar accumulation order.

ab_mapping.inference: Kernel contract Cijk_Ailk_Bljk means A(i,l)*B(l,j). Given row-major torch Q[M,K] and K[K,N], standard row-major-to-column-major GEMM adaptation swaps pointers, so expected runtime mapping is kernel A=key and B=query; query rows then lie along output C columns/the MFMA N axis.
ab_mapping.confidence: Inference, not directly proven by current artifacts: Chrome trace records kernel name/grid/correlation but not kernarg pointer values; AMD metadata names AddressA/AddressB but cannot bind them to Q/K at runtime. Do not claim the disassembly alone proves pointer identity.

fusion_assessment.candidate: A QK+softmax probe that keeps 4 or 8 query columns (logical query rows) across all 1536 key positions, then executes the exact validated wave64 softmax order and writes probabilities for the existing native PV.
constraints: MFMA N=16 means 4/8 active query columns waste 75%/50% of N width.
Score LDS may overlay QK input staging after the final MFMA/barrier; simultaneous staging plus score allocation is not required if lifetime is proven.
Need to derive AccVGPR-to-LDS key-contiguous/query-column layout from epilogue and preserve exact K accumulation, post-GEMM bias add, local exp/add/reduction order, and masked -inf slots.
48 KiB score storage leaves at most one CTA by 64 KiB LDS capacity; actual residency depends on allocation granularity and VGPR use, so no occupancy/performance claim.
fusion_assessment.first_check: Score-only exact probe against native QK before integrating softmax; compare score tensor bitwise. No performance expectation.
